subject: Post-call: FinTrust deployment route & network asks
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@fintrust.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: FinTrust deployment route & network asks

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + a short set of asks so we can scope the right deployment option (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC). CC'ing Karthik and Vanessa so they have visibility for pricing and the technical deep-dive.

Recap (high level)
- Primary requirement: data-in-place and network isolation for transaction-level logs (PCI scope)
- Throughput target: ~200 rps peak for inference; average latency SLO <= 200ms
- Preference expressed: lean to a Private VPC or on-prem installer for compliance reasons, but open to Dedicated with strict egress controls if Private VPC is infeasible

Network & security questions we need to unblock (please answer or share your network contact):
1) Preferred connectivity mode: AWS PrivateLink (endpoint per VPC) or VPC peering? If PrivateLink, do you require interface endpoints in multiple AZs?
2) Egress model: do you need static egress IPs to allowlist, or will a privatelink interface be sufficient? If IP allowlist required, how many / what subnets can you provision?
3) TLS & mTLS: do you require mutual TLS between FinTrust services and Redwood?
4) Audit/log retention: minimum retention window for request logs (we keep token-level traces separately)
5) Any data residency constraints beyond US (e.g., EU backups)?

Attachments: I attached a short network-reqs template and a draft mutual-action-plan to help fill gaps. Next steps we propose:
- If leaning Private VPC - schedule 60-minute network ops deep-dive next week (Vanessa + your network engineer)
- If Dedicated - we can share IP ranges and a sample egress allowlist for procurement
- Internal: Karthik will follow up on pricing/commit tiers; Naomi will coordinate dates for the technical call

Thanks — available today 3–5pm PT and Thursday morning for a quick follow.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: network-reqs-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual-action-plan-RDW-3492.docx (Word)
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@fintrust.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@fintrust.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTrust deployment route & network asks

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. We had an internal check and here are quick responses: 

1) Connectivity: Strong preference for PrivateLink. We want interface endpoints in at least 2 AZs.
2) Egress: We will likely want to allowlist static egress IPs for our IDS and perimeter firewall (we can provide the ranges). PrivateLink is preferred because it avoids public egress, but we still need the ability to pin a few egress IPs for upstream vendors.
3) mTLS: Yes, mTLS is required for service-to-service auth.
4) Audit retention: Minimum 12 months for request logs in our environment; we will need proof of log export/transfer process.
5) Residency: No additional regions — US only.

We attached our security questionnaire and I'll loop in our network engineer Aaron for the deep-dive. Proposed next steps from our side: schedule the network ops call early next week (Mon/Tue morning ET works). Also need a draft SOW and estimated committed capacity/pricing for Dedicated vs Private VPC so Procurement can review.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Security | FinTrust
priya.rao@fintrust.com
